section: CODE QUALITY AUDITING — Duplication, Maintainability Index & Lint

section: CODE QUALITY AUDITING — Duplication, Maintainability Index & Lint

section: CODE QUALITY AUDITING — Duplication, Maintainability Index & Lint

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA
description: Ranks identified dependency issues based on severity and exploitability, helping decide which patch to apply first when development time is limited.

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA

section: SECURITY WHITE-BOX — SAST, SCA

section: CONTROL FLOW TESTING — Statement, Branch & Path Coverage
description: Calculates the ratio of executed lines to total lines to show exactly where the holes are in your quality, measuring the thoroughness of the testing process.

description: % of executable source statements exercised by the test suite at least once

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: % of variable definition points (where variables are assigned) that are exercised by at least one test path

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Creates a bridge between where a variable is defined and at least one line of code where that specific value is later read or modified, measuring the integrity of the data journey.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Calculates the percentage of Definition-Use pairs that have been successfully exercised by your test suite, providing a deeper quality check than just seeing if a line was executed.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Identifies variables that are assigned a value but are never actually used by the program, helping reduce technical debt by spotting zombie variables that clutter memory without purpose.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Measures how the data flow reacts when a definition results in an unexpected state such as None or an overflow, identifying risks where valid variable definitions might lead to a crash at use.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Provides a verifiable report of the variable state at every stage of execution for debugging and compliance, ensuring that any data-related failure can be traced back to its specific definition point.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Identifies instances where a variable is used in a calculation or output statement, measuring the accuracy of data transformations and ensuring variable values correctly influence final results.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Identifies where a variable is used to determine the outcome of a decision, measuring how data values control the program execution flow and ensuring both True and False outcomes are tested.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Links every definition of a variable to all possible locations where that specific value could be read, creating a map of data influence across the function to ensure no use-case is left untested.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Confirms that every single identified Definition-Use pair (both c-use and p-use) has been executed at least once, measuring the total thoroughness of the test suite regarding data integrity.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Highlights specific variable uses that have never been reached during testing, helping developers find blind spots where a variable is defined but its impact on a calculation or branch is unverified.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Tracks variables that are redefined multiple times such as inside a loop or multiple if blocks, measuring the complexity of the data lifecycle to ensure the current value is always the intended one.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Monitors how variables such as arguments or global objects move between different functions, measuring the safety of the interfaces between code modules to prevent data corruption during hand-offs.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Identifies code blocks that attempt to use a variable but can never be executed due to logical constraints, helping clean up technical debt by removing logic that relies on impossible data states.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: Provides a detailed report showing which data paths are safe and which are risky, ensuring your MVP meets high-quality standards by providing an audit trail for every variable in the system.

section: DATA FLOW TESTING — All-Definition & All-Uses Coverage
description: % of definition-use pairs (variable defined, then used in computation or predicate) exercised by tests
